Now also projects items.validationErrors at every items[] read so any line-item-level rejection signal would surface — though VCST-5112 schema gap means destination-aggregate rejections still cannot surface through wishlist projections.

[ERRORS label=verify_dest] errors[] empty

[ERRORS label=verify_src] errors[] empty

Cross_Layer_Checks:
[ROUNDTRIP label=move] moveWishlistItem returns the DESTINATION wishlist state (itemsCount=1 after move). verify_dest also confirms destination=1, verify_src confirms source emptied.
[EVIDENCE] items[].validationErrors projection added for future-proofing — VCST-5112 schema gap means destination-aggregate rejections (PRODUCT_MIN_MAX_QTY etc.) cannot surface through wishlist projections today. WishlistType lacks the aggregate-level validationErrors field that CartType has.
